title: LOST IN TRANSLATION: MEASURING THE EFFECT OF NON-NATIVE ENGLISH ON END USER PERFORMANCE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a controlled dataset of real-world prompts translated into English with varying profiles of fluency (Content, Organization, Vocabulary, Language Use, and Mechanics) to measure how prompt fluency impacts the quality, surface form features, and rhetorical qualities of responses generated by 34 LLMs.
